name: Answers the numbers
description: Aggregate questions on the sample table, each with the figure the table gives: sum, average, median, count, max and min, by a column and by a period of the date column, plus describe. The agent is deterministic, so the bar is every case.

name: Keeps the table across turns
description: The table is attached once and asked about again: a second question, a period after a column, a table attached before the person was known, and the last question in what the agent remembers. All of it is the SDK's session and user memory, read back on a later turn.

name: Asks who it is talking to
description: A turn with no address and no asserted subject is asked for one, whether it brought a table, a question or a memory command, and nothing is answered before that. The identity gate is what keys long-term memory, so this is the suite that guards every other.
evaluators: Does not analyse an unknown person

name: Remembers, recalls and forgets
description: The memory commands, across turns of one conversation: remember then recall, remember then list, remember then forget then recall, remember then search, recall of nothing, and forget everything. Each case is its own person, so a run never meets another case's notes.
